content: Karwa Faara Isǝreela wa
Niya tsakh mee, karna Faara nafiyighǝn wa? Awo, ko ngguchit! Nggi tafad na tǝ lsǝreelarha ni, chichit Ibrahim, turya Mbenjemen.
Karwa Faara nafiyighǝn wur nǝn ka ƙǝtǝm wa. Sǝnggun ǝnɗi ndana laɓar Faara aten hwan nda Faara ǝnana annabi Iliya aten Isǝreelaya ndanǝn,
“Chinǝm, ɓǝlang nda annabi yiwa heu, fǝlang nda mbǝd fǝr satakh kiiwa ɗǝ, takhƙǝn nggi katenna kee, nggi ma min ndan sǝ ɓǝleerha.”
Ma nggǝrang na Faara sǝ? Nggǝranggǝn sǝ tǝ ndaarha, “Ɗǝfang ɗi fingya ɗǝ kumnggitghǝn mǝd ˈwa wagha tǝrang shilee ɗahad Mbaˈal teena”.
Nǝghǝn kee ƙǝm hu ƙǝshiid weeriya na fingya sǝ takhka, wurna nda kanda ka nggayirha.
Wurrǝ ɗi ki Faara ya ƙǝsǝr ka nggayidghǝn ni, mbǝ aten taara ǝnana nda ngga wa. Ƙǝsǝr ana wurra Faara nǝghǝn aten ˈya ǝnana fiya, ɓalwa nggayidghǝn tsaurha ka nggayirha wa.
Ƙǝn mbiya? Ƙǝɗeng Isǝreela ǝnɗi nǝn a kaɗaarha. Ƙǝl nafiya ngguchit ni kee ahur ndan wur nanda walgha, amma fingya takhka tsǝ tendan kakrak,
ƙǝla nanǝn chichirethlee hai tǝ ndaarha, “Fǝrang Faara sǝsǝn yamid sǝnda kanda, mbǝ yindan namana hai wa, thlǝmad ndan ƙǝm mba nda sǝk ˈya wa, ta weeri ɗaɓa ya.”
Ndagha Ndauda, “Ngwa tsauka wutsǝfayid ǝnnad ndan mii ka takhthleera tǝ lashi, fer kii saara, tǝ ˈya na mid ndan a wudgha tendan ɗǝ.
Ngwa wulgha yindan ama nanda namana hai, ƙǝbgha ƙǝsǝr ndan pakwanɗǝ.”
Hǝrǝkrha fingya mbuwa Yahudaya

Niya nggǝr tsakhmee, kiina Isǝreelaya saara, mbangwa nda thliirha sǝ wa? A yanggi, ko ngguchit. Ƙǝsǝr ka ɗimiyid ndan, sǝl hǝrǝkrha ten fingya ɗǝ mbuwa Yahudaya ka a kyang ngganda Yahudaya hu sǝrǝkkirha hai.

Amma ana ɗimiyidɗi ǝnana Isǝreelaya ɓang ɗǝ parka ƙǝshiirha ɓa, tǝƙǝm, ka ƙǝɗiina nda, ɓang ɗǝ parka fingya ɓa mbuwa Yahudaya, nanǝn kee, na hang nda parkadɗi ya a tsaurha ƙǝƙǝn a kyahar nda thlǝmad Faara ɓa.
Nanǝnya niyi a ndikrha tǝ kun mbuwa Yahudaya. Tsaunǝn nggini tǝ thlǝnda Yeeso yi fingya mbuwa Yahudaya, niyi a taala tǝ tarna,
hu shiteena kiya ni kyang shayina Isǝreelaya hu sǝrǝkkirha hai, tǝni hǝrghang fingya ahur ndan.
Ƙǝsǝr a tsau karrǝ ndan nǝn ɓang kwaman shaulirha ɓa a pathlang Faara tǝ ƙǝshiirha, na thlǝn ndan fa tsaurha ƙǝƙǝn? Nǝn a tsaurha wal yibrha ni a fingya mǝrgha.
A fǝr nda katǝra mburodi ngguchit a Faara na chahal, na mburodi heu tsaurha chahal. Ana thlar ɗǝfrha chahal, na wuhwar yini naarha chahal ƙǝm.

A kyathlang nda wuhwarya ɗǝ panǝm, tǝrang ngganda wuhwar ɗǝfǝd dzaitun na a kaheerha, wumang ngganda kanda kakhrha. Kun mbuwa Yahudaya, nuwun ƙǝla ɗǝfǝd dzaitun yi kaheerha, kun ni wumang nanda tǝ kul ɗi ya, ndǝna Yahudaya, a fad ndan ni nun a wal parkaya Faara.
A tǝr ɗun fad nun kalɗun fingya wuhwar yini kyathlang nanda kanda ɗǝ wa. A ǝnaɗun kee, a sǝnunsǝ, ɗanggun thlar ɗa sǝ wa, amma thlar ɗani ɗangga kun sǝ.
Na ndaarha, “Ai kyathlang nda wuhwar ɗa ɗǝ tǝna nda wumang nda kan.”
Nǝghǝn kee, kyathlang nanda kanda ɗǝ ƙǝsǝr fǝr wanda ƙǝkafek wa, amma kun ish ɗun ngga hu fǝrƙǝkafek. Nanǝn kee, ma tal ɗun wa, amma tǝrmama Faara.
Ƙǝsǝr a malangwa Faara ka wuhwar ɗi wa, kun ƙǝm mbǝ malang kun wa.

Tsaunǝn kee, ƙǝla nana Faara tǝ haɗang nda farha ni fa tǝƙǝm nǝghǝn ngyangthlang. Nǝghǝn ngyangthlang a fingya mbuwa fǝrƙǝkafek tǝghǝn, amma nǝn naarha tǝ hakkilo fa a kun a naɗun naarha a ɗǝrha mbeeɗǝ tǝ fǝrƙǝkafek tǝghǝn. Amma a malang ɗun fǝrƙǝkafek tǝghǝn na nda kyathlang kun ɗǝ ma kul ɗi.
A ɗǝwa nafiya Isǝreela mbeeɗǝ tǝ yamid fǝrƙǝkafek wa, na nda a wumang kanda, ƙǝsǝr na Faara tǝ sǝsǝmnda fa na a nggǝrghǝn wumang kanda.

Kun mbuwa Yahudaya nun ƙǝla ɗǝfǝd dzaitun yi kaheerha kyathlang nanda ɗǝ, nggǝra nda wumang kakhrha kanda tǝ yi wure pa nanda. Ənɗi ǝnanda ya mbu hu ǝntin kakhrha ɗǝfya dzaitun wa. Nanǝn kee, na Yahuda yini ƙǝla ɗǝf dzaitun yi wure, nǝn kukwasang Faara fa nggǝrghǝn wumang wuhwar yini kyalthgha ɗǝ hu kul ɗǝf yi ndan sǝ.
Na Faara haɗang kowunni fa

Nanǝn kee shayina, a nzǝm ɗun ndaarha nuwun tǝ thladwayirha fa wa, mbǝ miina sǝ a tsawun tǝ yamid sǝnda aten ƙǝkafekkidɗi na ɓǝɓee ya wa. Fingya Isǝreelaya na ten ndan kakrak, amma ƙǝl a kyad nafiya ɓa hangga mbuwa Yahudaya hu kutǝryid Faara ɗǝ.
Ahu kwamana kiya na Isǝreelaya heu a wal hǝrǝkrha. Ƙǝla nanǝn chichireethlee hai, “Tǝhǝrǝkrha nǝn a kyarhaɓa a Sihiyona, nǝn a kyakhrang yamid takkwa Faara ɓa na ahu Yakubu.
Ɗǝfmiina ni tǝ ǝna ni tǝ kanda tǝ ndaarha niya chahang ɗimiyid ndan kanda ɗǝ.”
Nafiya Isǝreelaya hangga nanǝnya a tsaurha tǝsarya Laɓara na Mbǝnggǝn, tǝnǝn ɗang kun sǝ. Amma kanda ni nggǝmna Faara, parkayid chichi yindan.
Ƙǝsǝr fǝrra Faara tǝ aadghǝn mbǝ tam kyakhrang hai wa.
ˈWanun tsaurha nafiya mbuwa manang Faara, amma nanǝnya haɗang nda kun fa ka yamid fǝr mamnggit ndan.
Nanǝn kee, kanda ƙǝm kar nda mii Faara fa na nda haɗang Faara fa ƙǝla haɗang na Faara kun fa.
Ƙǝsǝr ƙǝnang Faara kowunni ka kar mii ndan fa tǝna nda haɗang Faara fa heu.
Falla Faara
Ai kuɗimnda thladwayirha tǝ sǝnda Faara! Mbǝm mbang ƙǝƙǝrang nda ngwa kumadghǝn wa, tǝƙǝm kwamanggǝn kal ɗǝ sǝnda niifa mu.
Ƙǝla ndaana ɗeleewar Faara, “Wun ˈwagha sǝn hur Chinǝm? Wun ˈwagha tsaurha pashid shawaradghǝn?”
“Ma ˈwana niifa fǝrang Faara tsauka tǝta a tenggǝnǝn?”
Ƙǝsǝr a fadghǝn ni ɓa, tǝ ahurghǝn tǝƙǝm a ndǝghǝn ni na ǝngya heu. Ngwa tsauka mamnggirha yighǝn ni pakwanɗǝ. Atsaukake.
